display.purpose: Page titles, one per screen. Syne 800 carries the instrument-panel voice.

headline.purpose: Section and card titles; h1-h3 inherit Syne globally.

body.purpose: Default copy at 14px; the app runs mobile-dense. Prose caps at 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Signature caption voice (.hud-label). Once per screen as the header kicker; never section scaffolding.

section-label.purpose: Workhorse in-page heading: Schibsted 600, 13px, sentence case, text-secondary. Never uppercase or tracked. Data captions are the 11px/500 variant.

data.purpose: All counted/measured values: JetBrains Mono with tabular figures.

shadows.name: hairline-highlight
shadows.purpose: Top-edge light catch on glass panels.

shadows.name: ambient-float
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for cards needing separation (.shadow-smooth).

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Card at rest (.shadow-card); deepens to 0 8px 30px -4px on hover.

shadows.name: primary-glow
shadows.purpose: Emission for active/live/selected elements (.glow-primary). The Emission Rule: inactive elements never glow.

shadows.name: dock-float
shadows.purpose: The bottom nav dock — heaviest shadow in the system, reserved for the one floating chrome element.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Mechanical scale(0.96) press on touch targets. Doctrine: no bounce, no elastic overshoot on new work.

motion.name: aurora
motion.purpose: Atmospheric background drift; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: content-rail
breakpoints.purpose: max-w-md single-column rail; the app is phone-first.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solar Flare fill for the screen's primary action. Mechanical press, accent-tinted shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 8px 24px; background: var(--primary, #F07F13); color: var(--primary-fg, #221A12); font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(240,127,19,0.2); cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 160ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #D96F0B); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #F07F13); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Sunken-surface fill with hairline border for supporting actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 8px 24px; background: var(--bg-surface-2, #F6EEE1); color: var(--text-primary, #221A12); font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid var(--border, #EBDFCD); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 160ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-surface, #FFFFFF); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #F07F13); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Muted text-only action; surface tint appears on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 8px 24px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #6F6052); font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 200ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--bg-surface-2, #F6EEE1); color: var(--text-primary, #221A12); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #F07F13); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Sunken well with hairline border; primary ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--bg-surface-2, #F6EEE1); color: var(--text-primary, #221A12); font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #EBDFCD); border-radius: 8px; transition: box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-secondary, #6F6052); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #F07F13); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Opaque surface with hairline border; instrument numerals for the readout.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--bg-surface, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--border, #EBDFCD); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; max-width: 280px; transition: box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 30px -4px rgba(30,20,8,0.18); } .ds-card-kicker { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.25em; color: var(--text-secondary, #6F6052); } .ds-card-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary, #221A12); margin-top: 8px; } .ds-card-unit { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-secondary, #6F6052); } .ds-card-note { font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-secondary, #6F6052); margin: 8px 0 0; }

components.name: HUD Readout
components.description: Signature header pattern: pulsing glow dot + HUD microlabel. Once per screen.
components.css: .ds-hud { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-hud-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, #F07F13); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--primary, #F07F13); animation: ds-hud-pulse 3s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-hud-text { font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4em; color: var(--primary-text, #8A4708); } @keyframes ds-hud-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.6; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hud-dot { animation: none; } }

components.name: Nav Dock
components.description: Floating glass dock — the signature navigation. Active tab glows in accent with halo pill and underline bar.
components.html: HubPantryProfile
components.css: .ds-dock { display: flex; justify-content: space-around; align-items: center; height: 68px; max-width: 360px; padding: 0 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface, #FFFFFF) 75%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(40px); border: 1px solid var(--border, #EBDFCD); border-radius: 28px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06), 0 16px 40px -12px rgba(30,20,8,0.5); } .ds-dock-item { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; width: 56px; height: 100%; color: var(--text-secondary, #6F6052); opacity: 0.6; text-decoration: none; transition: color 300ms, opacity 300ms; } .ds-dock-item span { font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; } .ds-dock-item:hover { opacity: 1; } .ds-dock-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #F07F13); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-dock-active { color: var(--primary, #F07F13); opacity: 1; } .ds-dock-bar { position: absolute; bottom: 4px; width: 24px; height: 3px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, #F07F13); box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--primary, #F07F13); }

narrative.overview: Oteka's interface is a warm precision instrument — a cockpit for your own biology. The system pairs OLED-black warmth with a single saturated solar accent, instrument-grade numerals, and an atmospheric depth layer (a fixed aurora glow plus film grain) that keeps flat surfaces from feeling sterile. The personality is Modern, Minimalist, Precision-Focused: the warmth lives in the palette and the light, never in clutter or ornament. The system explicitly rejects the cluttered density of MyFitnessPal-style trackers, the sterile lifelessness of clinical/medical portals, the confetti-and-mascot noise of gamified fitness apps, and the interchangeable stat-card-grid look of generic SaaS dashboards. This is a phone-first, one-handed product: single-column max-w-md rails, floating bottom dock, primary actions in the thumb zone, motion in 150-300ms with crisp mechanical easing.
keyCharacteristics: Warm OLED dark mode and warm paper-light mode, both anchored by one solar accent
Four user-selectable accent channels (Solar default, Emerald, Cobalt, Midnight) that swap hue without changing structure
Instrument numerals: every number a user reads is tabular-lining mono
Depth by light emission (glows, hairlines, blur) rather than dark shadows
One signature caption voice: the HUD microlabel
Thumb-first ergonomics: bottom dock, ≥44px targets, safe-area aware

rules.name: The One Flare Rule
rules.body: The accent appears on less than 10% of any screen, and only ever means "live or actionable." If solar orange shows up as decoration, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Channel Rule
rules.body: Theme variants (.theme-emerald #0FA47A, .theme-cobalt #2F6BFF, .theme-midnight #8B5CF6) swap the accent channel and its tinted neutrals only. Structure, spacing, and type never change between channels — always style against var(--primary) and friends, never hardcoded orange.

rules.name: The Instrument Numeral Rule
rules.body: Every number a user reads — calories, grams, percentages, timers — renders in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures. Proportional digits in a readout are a defect.

rules.name: The One HUD Rule
rules.body: The HUD microlabel is a deliberate brand system, used once per screen as the header kicker. It is not section scaffolding: repeating tracked-uppercase eyebrows above every section is forbidden.

rules.name: The Emission Rule
rules.body: Active and live elements glow in the accent; inactive elements never do. Shadows are warm-tinted, diffuse, and low-opacity — a hard dark shadow reads as 2014 and is prohibited.

rules.name: The Earned Glass Rule
rules.body: Translucency + blur is reserved for chrome that floats above content: the dock, overlays, capture HUDs. Content cards are opaque surfaces. Glass as default card treatment is forbidden.

dos: Do style every component against the CSS custom properties (var(--primary), var(--bg-surface), var(--border)) so all four accent channels and both modes work for free.
Do use var(--primary-text) for accent-colored text/icons on light surfaces and var(--primary-fg) on primary fills — raw #F07F13 fails 4.5:1 against white and light surfaces.
Do set every number in JetBrains Mono tabular figures (the Instrument Numeral Rule).
Do keep touch targets ≥44px and primary actions in the thumb zone; pad fixed-bottom elements with pb-safe.
Do ship every interactive component with default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, and loading states — focus is a 2px primary ring at 2px offset, always.
Do provide prefers-reduced-motion alternatives for every animation, including the aurora and shimmer.
Do keep medical-guardrail and safety UI in plain, calm language with full-contrast text — trust beats theater.
donts: Don't recreate MyFitnessPal-style trackers: no ad-dense lists, no ten-deep settings mazes, no cramped logging tables.
Don't drift toward clinical/medical portals: no sterile gray form stacks, no bureaucratic density; warmth is part of the trust model.
Don't gamify like fitness apps: no confetti, badges, mascots, streak-shaming, or motivational gradients.
Don't assemble generic SaaS dashboards: no identical stat-card grids, no purple gradients, no hero-metric templates.
Don't use the legacy .gradient-text utility on new work — gradient text is prohibited; emphasis comes from weight, size, or solid Solar Flare.
Don't stack opacity modifiers on Umber/OLED Muted text (opacity-60, /50): it silently breaks 4.5:1 contrast. Use the token at full opacity or step up to ink.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px) as accents — full hairline borders or background tints instead.
Don't repeat tracked-uppercase microlabels above every section (the One HUD Rule: once per screen, in the header).
Don't add bounce or elastic easing; if it overshoots, it's off-brand.
Don't hardcode #F07F13 — the Channel Rule depends on var(--primary).
